derivation_premises: A user cannot operate what cannot be reached.
obligations.statement: A rotary input exists outside the enclosing body and is reachable by the user.

derivation_premises: Rotation and translation are different motions; something must convert one into the other.
obligations.statement: A relation exists that turns rotation of the input into translation of the platform, in both directions.

derivation_premises: A displacement can only be measured against a defined direction.
An unconstrained body driven by a converting element does not follow a definite path.
obligations.statement: The platform's path is constrained to a definite direction.

derivation_premises: A surface that carries a payload must keep the attitude that lets it carry it.
obligations.statement: The platform's orientation is preserved wherever the scenario depends on it.

derivation_premises: An unreacted load accelerates the body carrying it.
obligations.statement: The payload load reaches a reaction site through a connected path.

derivation_premises: An unreacted force accelerates the element.
Which components an element carries follows from the converting relation chosen, not from the requirement.
obligations.statement: Every element that carries a load component in the declared scenario has a reaction for that component.

derivation_premises: An external input driving an internal body must cross the boundary somewhere.
Crossing is not the same as escaping.
obligations.statement: The input crosses the enclosing boundary without any element leaving the enclosure during operation.

derivation_premises: A payload that cannot be placed cannot be supported.
obligations.statement: A path exists by which a payload is placed on and removed from the platform, terminating at the platform.

derivation_premises: The text names a hand-operated input and no other source.
obligations.statement: The product is driven only by the user's input; no stored or supplied energy source drives the motion.

derivation_premises: A part with no path into the partly built product cannot be installed.
obligations.statement: An ordered installation sequence exists in which every part has a clear path in the configuration produced by the preceding steps.

derivation_premises: A relation that ceases to transmit within its own range does not perform the required motion.
obligations.statement: The converting relation continues to produce output motion throughout the travel.

obligations.statement: An enclosed volume exists that contains the moving elements and carries the platform.

unresolved.decision: which converting relation the product uses
unresolved.why_open: Six principle families satisfy the conversion obligation and nothing in the requirements distinguishes them. Travel is a band, not a stroke; no packaging envelope is stated; no holding behaviour is required.

unresolved.decision: whether the product must hold its position when the input is released
unresolved.why_open: The requirements ask for raising and lowering and are silent on holding. The answer changes which families remain admissible, because some are self-locking and some are not.

unresolved.decision: whether the enclosure may be opened for payload access
unresolved.why_open: Enclosure during operation and payload access are both required and the requirements do not say whether an aperture is permitted.
